channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Harshvardhan Rane shoots wildlife in freezing minus-one temperature
item.description: Actor Harshvardhan Rane on Wednesday shared a video on his social media account where he was seen braving sub-zero temperatures while indulging in wildlife photography.

item.title: ECI announces schedule for Rajya Sabha biennial elections to fill 37 seats
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Wednesday declared the schedule for the biennial elections to the Council of States, Rajya Sabha, to fill 37 seats falling vacant from 10 states.

item.title: When Salman Khan said he did nothing in ‘Karan Arjun’ still received all the credit for its success
item.description: In one of his old television interviews with Lehrein TV, Bollywood superstar Salman Khan was seen candidly talking about the unpredictability of box office success and how he has often struggled to understand the audience’s response to his films.

item.title: Bihar Class 10 girl found dead on railway tracks; family says denial of exam entry led to suicide
item.description: A student, who was to appear for the Class 10 examination, was found dead near the railway track in a village in Bihar, said police on Wednesday.

item.title: Kiara Advani pens note for late father-in-law: You leave behind a legacy of gentleness
item.description: Actress Kiara Advani shared an emotional note in remembrance of her late father-in-law Sunil Malhotra, expressing gratitude for the unconditional love and warmth she received from the very beginning. Kiara took to Instagram, where she shared two monochrome pictures.

item.title: PM Modi set to visit TN twice in March as NDA gears up for Assembly polls
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to visit Tamil Nadu twice in March as part of an intensified campaign push ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections, according to political sources.

item.title: Jammu & Kashmir beat Bengal to reach maiden Ranji Trophy final
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir have stormed into their first-ever Ranji Trophy final with a six-wicket win over Bengal on day four of their semi-final at the Bengal Cricket Academy ground on Wednesday.

item.title: India, Nepal sign updated mutual legal assistance agreement
item.description: India and Nepal have signed an updated Agreement on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters in Kathmandu, enabling the competent authorities of the two countries to cooperate in criminal investigations and legal proceedings.

item.title: Andhra horror: Suspect in minor girl’s rape, murder found dead
item.description: The body of the suspect in the rape and murder of a seven-year-old girl was found in a lake in Andhra Pradesh's Annamayya district on Wednesday, police said.

item.title: Disorganised PR spectacle, Indian data up for sale, Chinese products showcased: Rahul Gandhi on AI Summit
item.description: As India-AI Impact Summit 2026 entered its third day, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Wednesday criticised the event, alleging that it was being run more as a publicity exercise than a serious platform to strengthen India’s artificial intelligence ecosystem.
